blocks.en: The penultimate understanding, the eternal Truth, and present.
blocks.ro: Penultima înțelegere, Adevărul etern și prezent.

blocks.en: It has revealed itself on the highest mountain, uttering unto itself one vowel and four consonants: S, T, N, M, and A.
blocks.ro: S-a revelat pe cel mai înalt munte, rostindu-și o vocală și patru consoane: S, T, N, M și A.

blocks.en: The highest accomplishment in understanding is to experience the Truth: a great striving, a greater path into our soul memory: “A-Lethia” in Ancient Greek, the power to remember and move away from "Lethargos," or the unconscious sleep of ignorance.
blocks.ro: Cea mai înaltă realizare a înțelegerii este trăirea Adevărului: o mare strădanie, o cale și mai mare către memoria sufletului nostru: „A-Lethia” în greaca veche, puterea de a ne aminti și de a ne îndepărta de "Lethargos", adică somnul inconștient al ignoranței.

blocks.en: Blessed are those who are the lovers of Truth.
blocks.ro: Binecuvântați sunt cei care iubesc Adevărul.

blocks.en: But soul must be given to Them,

emphasis.text: But soul must be given to Them,
emphasis.ro: Dar trebuie să Li se dea suflet,

blocks.ro: Dar trebuie să Li se dea suflet,

blocks.en: Ὦ Σάτυα, τῶν τεσσάρων γραμμάτων κύριε,
blocks.ro: Ὦ Σάτυα, τῶν τεσσάρων γραμμάτων κύριε,

blocks.en: Ō Satya, tōn tessarōn grammatōn kyrie, S, T, N, M, pros tēn alētheian agousin; psykhēn de doteon autois, syn tōi A.
blocks.ro: Ō Satya, tōn tessarōn grammatōn kyrie, S, T, N, M, pros tēn alētheian agousin; psykhēn de doteon autois, syn tōi A.

blocks.en: The prayer joins the four named consonants with A and asks that the letters be animated by soul on the way to truth.
blocks.ro: Rugăciunea unește cele patru consoane numite cu A și cere ca literele să fie însuflețite pe drumul către adevăr.

blocks.en: Ἡ πρὸ τοῦ τέλους σύνεσις, ἡ αἰώνιος καὶ παροῦσα ἀλήθεια.
blocks.ro: Ἡ πρὸ τοῦ τέλους σύνεσις, ἡ αἰώνιος καὶ παροῦσα ἀλήθεια.

blocks.en: Ἐπὶ τοῦ ὑψίστου ὄρους ἀπεκαλύφθη, ἓν φωνῆεν καὶ τέσσαρα σύμφωνα ἑαυτῇ φθεγγομένη· S, T, N, M καὶ A.
blocks.ro: Ἐπὶ τοῦ ὑψίστου ὄρους ἀπεκαλύφθη, ἓν φωνῆεν καὶ τέσσαρα σύμφωνα ἑαυτῇ φθεγγομένη· S, T, N, M καὶ A.

blocks.en: Τὸ ὕψιστον τῆς συνέσεως κατόρθωμά ἐστι τὴν ἀλήθειαν πειρᾶσθαι· μέγας ὁ ἀγών, μείζων δὲ ἡ πρὸς μνήμην τῆς ψυχῆς ὁδός. Ἡ ἀλήθεια ἀπὸ τῆς λήθης ἀπάγει καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀσυνειδήτου ὕπνου τῆς ἀγνοίας.
blocks.ro: Τὸ ὕψιστον τῆς συνέσεως κατόρθωμά ἐστι τὴν ἀλήθειαν πειρᾶσθαι· μέγας ὁ ἀγών, μείζων δὲ ἡ πρὸς μνήμην τῆς ψυχῆς ὁδός. Ἡ ἀλήθεια ἀπὸ τῆς λήθης ἀπάγει καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀσυνειδήτου ὕπνου τῆς ἀγνοίας.

blocks.en: Hē pro tou telous synesis, hē aiōnios kai parousa alētheia.
blocks.ro: Hē pro tou telous synesis, hē aiōnios kai parousa alētheia.

blocks.en: Epi tou hypsistou orous apekalyphthē, hen phōnēen kai tessara symphōna heautēi phthengomenē; S, T, N, M kai A.
blocks.ro: Epi tou hypsistou orous apekalyphthē, hen phōnēen kai tessara symphōna heautēi phthengomenē; S, T, N, M kai A.

blocks.en: To hypsiston tēs syneseōs katorthōma esti tēn alētheian peirasthai; megas ho agōn, meizōn de hē pros mnēmēn tēs psykhēs hodos. Hē alētheia apo tēs lēthēs apagei kai apo tou asyneidētou hypnou tēs agnoias.
blocks.ro: To hypsiston tēs syneseōs katorthōma esti tēn alētheian peirasthai; megas ho agōn, meizōn de hē pros mnēmēn tēs psykhēs hodos. Hē alētheia apo tēs lēthēs apagei kai apo tou asyneidētou hypnou tēs agnoias.
